text: Shareable open link: an Aimparency URL that opens a Git repo read-only
description: A link such as http://localhost:4000/?repo=<git-url> opens that repository read-only directly, so maintainers can put a 'view the idea graph' link in a README and Aimparency users reach it in one click. Depends on opening from a Git URL. Viewers still run Aimparency locally; a public hosted viewer is out of scope unless decided separately.
